tool.excerpt: == Incident == At approximately 00:45 BST on 27 September 2026, police received a call concerning three suspicious vehicles that appeared to be heading towards the base. Armed officers arrested five men in the Whelford area, about 3.2 km from the base, on suspicion of offences under the Explosive act, and they were further arrested on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act under section 5 of the Terrorism Act 2006. Police established a 400-metre cordon around the vehicles, which were examined by British Army explosive ordnance disposal personnel. CNN reporters near the perimeter fence heard what sounded like two controlled detonations from the direction of Whelford. == Investigation == On 27 September, Deputy Assistant Commissioner Vicki Evans of Counter Terrorism Policing said the investigation was at an early stage and that the five man remain in custody. ... On 27 September 2026, police arrested five men near RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire, England, a Royal Air Force station used by the United States Air Force, on suspicion of offence under the Explosives Act 1875 and of preparing a terrorist attack. The police said the arrest followed a report of three suspicious vehicles travelling towards the base. A major incident was declared and about 85 households were evacuated while British Army bomb disposal specialists examined the vehicles. Counter Terrorism Police took over investigation.
